THE MINI CONCEPT ACEMAN.

*The MINI Concept Aceman is a concept car only, meaning it is not in production and not for sale. Therefore, it cannot be driven on public roads and is not compliant to road regulations. Filming took place on a closed road/studio with no access to traffic.

THE EMOTION OF (E-)MOTION.

The MINI Concept Aceman represents a new era of more sustainable, connected cars and combines tech advances, charismatic simplicity and driving excitement.

Our first all-electric MINI Crossover SAV blends in hallmark MINI agility and innovative design thinking, while delivering an assured driving position. It showcases what makes a MINI: exciting proportions, distinctive lines and clever functionality. Agile and powerful, yet with a sense of timeless sophistication, the MINI Concept Aceman is the start of a new adventure.

THE AESTHETICS OF SPONTANEITY.

  • Inspirational all-electric driving performance and the latest innovations in elelctric technology.
  • All-new intelligent architecture, providing form, flexibility and functinality.
  • Innovative interactive technology and multi-screen infotainment connect passengers with an unprecedented user experience.
  • Chrome and leather-free material integrates upholstery surfaces and textiles made from recycled materials.

THE FUTURE OF TRADITION-STEEPED DESIGN.

The MINI Concept Aceman is a modern interpretation of the SAV, but in agile MINI form. Its clearly defined contours and clean edges make a compelling impact.

SPORTY, STYLISH ICON – REINTERPRETED.
Assertive and powerful the large, octagonal grille and exciting, bold design details at the front lend menance and sensuality at the same time.
A FINE SENSE OF PROPORTION.
Even from a distance, the MINI Concept Aceman’s compact proportions make it unmistakably MINI. With short overhangs and functional two-box design, this car takes the MINI maxim "Clever Use of Space" to new heights.
STRIKING SURFACES AND ASSURED EDGINESS.
Clear, carefully modelled surfaces blend with precise contours to make a compelling statement. The door openers and glass surfaces complete the look.
ATH-LED-IC AT THE BACK.
The digital Matrix LED taillights allow you to choose between different signatures and highlight the adventurous side of the MINI Concept Aceman.
20" ALLOY WHEELS WITH A MINI TWIST.
At first glance, the wheels seem familiar enough. Look again and you notice the “embossed” triangle around the centre that creates a whole new depth and dynamism.

INTERIOR STYLE – A NEW MINIMALISM.

The interior of the MINI Concept Aceman combines classic and sporty MINI design elements with elegant handcrafted touches throughout. The spacious open areas around the doors and the soft surfaces bring warmth and a sense of wellbeing, and the panoramic roof lets the light flood in.
ICONIC DASHBOARD.
The dashboard, reminiscent of a surfboard, floats horizontally in one long beautiful curve. The entire length serves as a stage for animated projections which, in combination with especially created sound collages, lets you explore the effects of a completely new interior experience. The unique iridescent PVD coating conjures up a brilliant colour spectrum in shimmering metallic.
SPACIOUS INTERIOR DESIGN.
The transparent floating central console, which is open at the top and extends into the rear, lets you add a wireless charging area, cupholders or other components depending on your mood. The free-floating design combined with the panoramic roof makes the car feel open and airy.
TOGGLES – FUTURE REVISITED.
Directly below the dashboard sits the newly interpreted toggle bar. It's the only analog control element in the MINI Concept Aceman and integrates the parking brake, gear selection, start/stop function, selection of the experience modes and volume control.
THE POWER OF CREATIVE SEATING.
The front and rear seats are visually and ergonomically beautiful. Made of combinations of flat knit, velvet velour and waffle fabric in sublte colour combinations, they blend perfectly into the interior with the headrest and surfaces flowing gently into each other.
INNOVATIVE DOOR DESIGN.
The doors also follow the minimalist design approach and form strong yet inviting structures made with soft surfaces. The upholstered free-standing door handle and speaker provide an exciting contrast to the rest of the interior and enhance the user experience further.

DESIGNED TO TURN HEADS.

The compelling light turquoise hue adds to the sense of excitement. Depending on the way the light falls, the colour appears brighter or darker, which lends a subtle three-dimensionality to the surfaces and edges. The roof rack is in British Racing Green and thanks to the chameleon effect of the PVD coating, it shimmers in different shades of blue, purple, green, turquoise and pink.

A STEP INTO THE SUSTAINABLE FUTURE. 

Crafted with the highest attention to detail and quality the sustainable materials are all made of recycled plastics. In combination with the colour nuances an astonishing interplay of contrasts delivers a highly emotional driving experience.

HIGHLIGHTS.

SOUNDS INVITING?

The MINI Concept Aceman's exterior showcases a whole new approach to user interface and user interaction design with features that light up, blink or greet you with inviting sounds.

THE "MATRIX LED EYES".

Enclosed by the daytime running light rings, the Matrix LED structure in the front grille, and green contour lighting of the grille combine to create a whole different light experience.

YOUR TRUSTY MINI COMPANION.

This sensor-based light animation is activated when you approach the vehicle. A cloud of light in the front area of the vehicle follows you and becomes brighter as you approach. The front lights blink and there is a special Earcon sound to greet you.

THE SOUND OF COLOUR.

The opening of the door triggers a universe of colours and sounds that combine to transport you into a whole new magical world. The Colour Burst sound is a swirl of overlapping tones which spool backwards and forwards.

ADVANCED VISUAL AUDIO.

Depending on the mode, the contents of the OLED display are extended to the entire dashboard by animated projections, so that in combination with specially developed sounds, a you can enjoy a completely new experience in the interior every time.

DRIVE YOUR CHOICE – EXPERIENCE MODES.

Immerse yourself in different worlds inside the MINI Concept Aceman. Three new experience modes show different ways to operate and enjoy the displays at your disposal. So indulge and bring your interior to life.

PERSONAL MODE.

This is all about personalising the displays. You can select from an array of subtly animated background images which are also projected onto the dashboard and accompanied by curated sounds. Some examples include clouds moving in the sky, waves breaking on the shore and glittering water moving in a swimming pool.

POP-UP MODE.

The Pop-Up mode is the first experience-oriented navigation to be offered in a MINI - it even includes the element of surprise. You can decide where you want to go by selecting an experience category such as dining out, events, trends, or spinning an animated wheel of fortune.

VIVID MODE.

The MINI Concept Aceman's Vivid Mode makes every journey more playful, interactive and fun. In this mode, you can create a completely new interactive design for the entire display area whenever the vehicle is stationary.

FIND THE RIGHT MINI FOR YOU.

All our MINIs were concepts at some point in their lives. Take a look at the current range of new and exciting MINIs available and choose the right one for you.
